dates.text: St Ignatius, who was the third Bishop of Antioch from 70 to 107, the date of his martyrdom. [...] "Having left Smyrna", he "wrote again": two letters to the Churches of Philadelphia and Smyrna, and one to Bishop Polycarp.
dates.notes: Benedict XVI, General Audience, 14 March 2007. Dates Ignatius's martyrdom to 107; the letters (incl. Ephesians, from Smyrna) were written on that journey. Used for Ch. 10 'Around the year 107'.
